linnaeite.definition:
n. A mineral of pale steel-gray color and metallic luster,
   occurring in isometric crystals, and also massive. It is a sulphide of
   cobalt containing some nickel or copper.

linnean.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Linnaeus, the celebrated Swedish
   botanist.
